description:
Search and filter events within a specific issue.

Provide `query` as natural language or Sentry event search syntax. When an embedded agent is configured, it fixes filters and time range before running. Results are always newest first; fields and sort only shape the Sentry link.

The tool automatically constrains results to the specified issue.

Common Query Filters:
- environment:production - Filter by environment
- release:1.0.0 - Filter by release version
- user.email:alice@example.com - Filter by user
- trace:TRACE_ID - Filter by trace ID

For cross-issue searches use search_issues. For single issue or event details use get_sentry_resource.

<examples>
search_issue_events(issueId='MCP-41', organizationSlug='my-org', query='from last hour')
search_issue_events(issueId='MCP-41', organizationSlug='my-org', query='environment:production')
search_issue_events(issueUrl='https://sentry.io/.../issues/123/', query='release:v1.0.0', period='7d')
</examples>

includeExplanation.description: Include explanation of how the query was translated or repaired

issueId.description: Issue ID (e.g., 'MCP-41', 'PROJECT-123'). Requires organizationSlug. Alternatively, use issueUrl.

issueUrl.description: Full Sentry issue URL (e.g., 'https://sentry.io/organizations/my-org/issues/123/'). Includes both organization and issue ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-100, default: 50)

anyOf.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

organizationSlug.description: Organization slug. Required when using issueId. Not needed when using issueUrl.

period.description: Relative time window, such as `30m`, `1h`, `24h`, `7d`, or `90d`. Controls which records fall within the search window.

anyOf.description: The project's slug. You can find a list of existing projects in an organization using the `find_projects()` tool.

projectSlug.description: Project slug for better tag discovery. Optional - helps find project-specific tags.

query.description: Natural language or Sentry event search query syntax for filtering within the issue.

anyOf.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'. For self-hosted Sentry installations, this parameter is usually not needed and should be omitted. You can find the correct regionUrl from the organization details using the `find_organizations()` tool.

regionUrl.description: Sentry region URL. Optional - defaults to main region.

sort.description: Sort for the Sentry link (prefix with - for descending). Results are always newest first. Default: -timestamp

name: search_issue_events

events.description: Newest first; the issue events endpoint has no sort.

title: Search Issue Events
